app.name: SaqBol
app.tagline: Check a message before you lose money
home.lead: Paste a message, SMS or chat you are unsure about. SaqBol marks the exact words that make it look like a scam, names the script it follows, and tells you what to do next.
form.label: Message to check
form.error.empty: Paste a message or add a screenshot first.
form.error.too_long: That message is longer than {max} characters. Paste the important part.
form.error.failed: The check could not be completed. Try again in a moment.
form.error.rate_limited: Daily limit reached. Try again later.
form.error.turnstile: Please confirm you are human, then check again.
form.turnstile.hint: That is a few checks in a row. Confirm you are human to keep going.
form.samples.title: Or try one of these
form.samples.hint: Real scam scripts, plus one genuine bank notification.
form.image.label: Or a screenshot
form.image.hint: Drop a screenshot here or choose a file. PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 5 MB.
form.image.too_large: That file is over 5 MB. Try a smaller screenshot, or paste the text.
form.image.wrong_type: Only PNG, JPEG or WebP will work.
form.image.unsupported: Screenshot checks are not enabled on this server. Copy the text of the message and paste it in the box above.
form.image.no_text: We could not find any message text in that screenshot. Copy the text of the message and paste it in the box above.
form.image.unreadable: The screenshot could not be read right now. Try again in a moment, or copy the text of the message and paste it in the box above.
card.text.title: The message, with the evidence marked
card.evidence.unanchored: {n} piece(s) of evidence could not be located in the text and are not marked above.
share.title: Warn someone
share.warning.likely_safe: No signs of a scam were found, but stay alert.
share.page.lead: SaqBol recognises this script from the text of a message. Check yours — it is free and takes a second.
mock.banner: Demo data. The analysis backend is not connected in this build.
stats.title: Statistics
stats.lead: What SaqBol has been asked to check. Counts only: the messages themselves are never shown here.
stats.meta.description: How many messages SaqBol has checked, what share were scams, and which scam scripts are most common this week.
stats.devices.note: “Distinct devices” is the number of distinct devices seen each day, added up over 30 days. A device that comes back on another day is counted again, so this is more than the number of people.
stats.chart.title: Checks per day
stats.top.title: Top scenarios this week
stats.top.days: Most common on {n} of the last 7 days
stats.top.empty: No scenario has stood out yet.
stats.unavailable: Statistics are unavailable right now. Try again in a few minutes.
library.title: Scam scenarios
library.lead: The scripts SaqBol recognises: how each one starts, how it earns your trust, and where the money goes. Read them before someone reads them to you.
library.meta.description: Every scam script SaqBol recognises, with the red flags, how it unfolds step by step, and what to do.
